stem: Which description best defines appropriate attire in a professional IT environment?
explanation: Dress to match the required attire of the environment (formal or business casual), as set by the company dress code.
options: Casual clothing with minimal branding
Clothing that prioritizes comfort
Clothing that adheres to company dress code
Clothing suitable for physical labor
correctAnswer: Clothing that adheres to company dress code

stem: Which approach best demonstrates effective communication with a customer in a technical support scenario?
explanation: Use plain language and avoid jargon, acronyms and slang when applicable.
options: Describe the issue with precise, technical terms to avoid any ambiguity
Use technical abbreviations to streamline the communication process
Avoid using jargon, acronyms, and slang when applicable
Describe the issue using informal language to simplify the explanation
correctAnswer: Avoid using jargon, acronyms, and slang when applicable

stem: A technician is troubleshooting a recurring software issue while the user expresses frustration. Which behavior best demonstrates maintaining a positive attitude?
explanation: Stay calm and respectful and acknowledge the frustration. Don't promise a fix time you can't guarantee.
options: Focusing exclusively on resolving the issue without engaging the user
Promising a definitive fix time regardless of the actual troubleshooting progress
Informing the user that similar issues are common and unavoidable
Acknowledging the user's frustration while remaining calm and respectful
correctAnswer: Acknowledging the user's frustration while remaining calm and respectful

stem: Which of the statements listed below best describes projecting confidence in a customer support role?
explanation: Projecting confidence means showing competence while setting realistic expectations, not overpromising or brushing off the customer.
options: Reassuring the customer by minimizing the perceived complexity of the issue
Providing a definitive repair timeline before completing a full diagnostic
Communicating assurance and competence while managing expectations
Minimizing the customer's questions to maintain control of the interaction
correctAnswer: Communicating assurance and competence while managing expectations

stem: A customer begins describing a printing issue in detail. Which action best demonstrates active listening according to professional support standards?
explanation: Actively listen and avoid interrupting the customer.
options: Interrupting to confirm understanding of something stated earlier in the description
Politely cutting in to redirect a lengthy or off-topic story back to the main technical issue
Listening without interrupting until the customer finishes describing the problem
Correcting the customer's technical terminology or phrasing during their explanation
correctAnswer: Listening without interrupting until the customer finishes describing the problem

stem: Which behavior best reflects the guideline to use appropriate professional titles and designations?
explanation: Use appropriate professional titles and designations when applicable, e.g. Dr. for someone who identifies as a PhD holder.
options: Relying on generic respectful terms when unsure about the provided title
Applying titles or designations only when explicitly requested to do so
Omitting titles entirely to focus attention on the technical problem
Addressing a self-identified PhD holder as Dr. followed by the last name
correctAnswer: Addressing a self-identified PhD holder as Dr. followed by the last name

stem: Which actions best demonstrate proper time management in customer support interactions? (Select 2 answers)
explanation: Be on time by planning ahead, and if you will be late, contact the customer.
options: Relying on the customer to reschedule if a delay occurs
Planning travel and preparation to avoid delays
Offering extra service time to compensate for late arrival
Contacting the customer promptly if running late
Depending on customer understanding of common overruns
correctAnswer: Planning travel and preparation to avoid delays
Contacting the customer promptly if running late

stem: Which of the following activities are considered unprofessional distractions that should be avoided in a customer support scenario? (Select 3 answers)
explanation: Avoid distractions such as personal calls, texting/social media and personal interruptions (including side conversations with co-workers).
options: Photographing damaged equipment
Texting or using social media sites
Answering a supervisor's call
Engaging in personal conversations with co-workers
Taking personal calls
correctAnswer: Texting or using social media sites
Engaging in personal conversations with co-workers
Taking personal calls

stem: Which practice most directly supports the guideline to not argue with the customer or be defensive?
explanation: Don't argue or get defensive. Listen to the complaint without counterarguments.
options: Asking the customer to remain calm before continuing
Redirecting the discussion to a different topic
Escalating the issue immediately to avoid conflict
Avoiding counterarguments when facing complaints
correctAnswer: Avoiding counterarguments when facing complaints

stem: Which of the actions listed below align with the guideline to avoid dismissing customer issues? (Select 3 answers)
explanation: Take every symptom seriously, restate the concern and ask open-ended questions. Interrupting or saying the problem is common dismisses the customer.
options: Treating every reported symptom as legitimate until investigated
Restating the customer's concern to confirm understanding
Asking open-ended questions to better understand the complaint
Clarifying customer statements by interrupting them if necessary
Pointing out that the problem is common among other customers
correctAnswer: Treating every reported symptom as legitimate until investigated
Restating the customer's concern to confirm understanding
Asking open-ended questions to better understand the complaint

stem: Which of the following actions align with avoiding being judgmental in a technical support scenario? (Select 3 answers)
explanation: Avoid being judgmental by asking open-ended questions, making no assumptions about their knowledge, and focusing on facts and solutions.
options: Reassuring the customer that the mistake is understandable for non-technical users
Asking open-ended questions to better understand the complaint
Treating the customer's technical knowledge level without assumption or criticism
Focusing on facts and solutions rather than the customer's past decisions
Advising the customer to stop experimenting with settings they don't understand
correctAnswer: Asking open-ended questions to better understand the complaint
Treating the customer's technical knowledge level without assumption or criticism
Focusing on facts and solutions rather than the customer's past decisions

stem: In a customer support scenario, which actions best demonstrate the ability to clarify customer statements? (Select 3 answers)
explanation: Clarify by restating the issue, asking questions to confirm details, and asking open-ended questions to narrow the scope.
options: Restating the customer's description to verify understanding
Aligning communication style with the customer's technical level
Correcting the customer's use of non-technical language
Questioning to confirm key details of the reported problem
Asking open-ended questions to narrow the scope of the issue
correctAnswer: Restating the customer's description to verify understanding
Questioning to confirm key details of the reported problem
Asking open-ended questions to narrow the scope of the issue

stem: Which of the practices listed below do not align with the guideline on maintaining discretion when discussing past customer encounters? (Select 2 answers)
explanation: Don't discuss specific customer experiences outside work or post them on social media. Anonymized examples are fine.
options: Focusing on technical details when describing issues
Discussing specific customer experiences outside work
Avoiding specific customer names or locations
Posting details of a customer interaction on a personal social media account
Using anonymized examples in training or meetings
correctAnswer: Discussing specific customer experiences outside work
Posting details of a customer interaction on a personal social media account

stem: After diagnosing a failed motherboard on a laptop that is out of warranty, a technician determines the repair cost is nearly equal to a new system. Which of the following is the most professional course of action?
explanation: Offer repair/replacement options as needed and let the customer decide.
options: Present both options but emphasize repair as better value
Quote only the repair cost without mentioning replacement price
Recommend replacing the laptop with a new system
Offer both repair and replacement options to the customer
correctAnswer: Offer both repair and replacement options to the customer

stem: After finishing a repair and verifying full system functionality, what is the most important final step to complete the service workflow?
explanation: After the repair, provide the customer with proper documentation of the services performed.
options: Providing the customer with proper documentation of the services performed
Asking the customer to sign a waiver stating that no other components were damaged
Identifying potential negative impacts of the implemented solution
Updating internal documentation with the hardware manufacturer's information
correctAnswer: Providing the customer with proper documentation of the services performed

stem: After resolving a customer issue, following up at a later date to verify satisfaction is optional unless the customer reports a new problem.
explanation: False. Following up with the customer/user later to verify satisfaction is part of the expected process.
options: True
False
correctAnswer: False

stem: Which of the answers listed below describes appropriate handling of the customer's confidential data in a situation where troubleshooting requires access to a password-protected system?
explanation: Have the user enter their own password so you never learn it, which respects the customer's confidential and private material.
options: Create a temporary account with the same permissions
Ask user to type in the password themselves
Temporarily disable password protection
Ask user for password and their consent to use it
correctAnswer: Ask user to type in the password themselves
